basics.name: Kavya Ramatatagari
basics.summary: I build across the stack: React, Next.js and Node on the front, C# and .NET microservices on Azure at Schneider Electric, Java for backend platform work. AI/ML is what I'm curious about next — EEG-based cognitive load classification and quantum datasets both taught me the data matters more than the model. I care about tests that catch real problems and services that stay up.

experience.summary: Backend services and microservices in C# and .NET, on Azure and Docker.
highlights: Developed backend services and microservices with C# and .NET, leveraging Azure cloud technologies and Docker, following Agile practices with a focus on scalability, reliability and seamless system integration.
Customised the Windchill backend platform with Java and developed the accompanying test cases.
Write and maintain unit, service-level and domain-level test cases to ensure code quality, stability and seamless integration.

experience.summary: Led the design and development of quantum datasets.
highlights: Led the design and development of diverse quantum datasets for quantum machine learning, quantum algorithms and image processing tasks.
